title: First attempt fails
label: ATTEMPT 1
caption: At 0s the caller sends the request and the service answers 503. The loop treats it as retryable instead of returning it.

title: Wait 1s
label: WAIT 1S
caption: The delay is base × 2^(attempt − 1), so 1s after the first failure. The caller sleeps and sends nothing.

title: Second attempt fails
label: ATTEMPT 2
caption: At 1s the caller tries again and gets another 503.

title: Wait 2s
label: WAIT 2S
caption: The delay doubles to 2s, so the next attempt lands at 3s. Each failure gives the service longer to recover.

title: Third attempt succeeds
label: ATTEMPT 3
caption: At 3s the service answers 200. The loop returns that response, after 3s spent waiting.

title: Wait 4s
label: WAIT 4S
caption: The delay doubles again to 4s. Attempts thin out as failures pile up, so a struggling service is not hammered.

title: Last attempt fails
label: ATTEMPT 4
caption: At 7s the fourth attempt, the maximum, gets a 503 too.

title: Give up
label: GIVE UP
caption: With no attempts left, the loop stops and throws the last 503 to the caller instead of waiting 8s more.
